title: Personal NOC Wall Daily Health Score
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:score
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(overall_score) as avg_score, min(overall_score) as worst_score by _time
| eval wall_state=case(worst_score<60,"red",worst_score<80,"yellow",1=1,"green")
| sort _time
description: Builds a daily top-line health score for your personal NOC wall so the whole life stack can be summarized in one tile.
value: A single score helps you decide whether the day looks operationally normal or whether multiple little problems are stacking up.
implementation: Compute `overall_score` from your cross-stream dashboards and publish one `lifeos:score` event per day.
visualization: Single-value tile for current score with a supporting daily trend.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It tracks your own life-health dashboard score so you can tell if the day looks calm or messy at a glance.
